fullPassage: Vera couldn't wait for her car to get fixed, but that was going to require longer than initially expected. Unfortunately, that meant relying on the bus for her commute. To add to the cruel irony, it hadn't stopped raining for the past three days. It was already past 7 PM when she stepped off the bus, cold and soaked to the bone, having left her umbrella at the gym. Her place was just one block down the street, but it felt like ten miles in this weather. Her legs moved on their own, and suddenly, the Cups & Blossoms' bell was ringing above her head. The warm, floral scent wrapped around her like a blanket, but it was another kind of welcome that surprised her — a smile from the café owner, soft and unassuming. She was also polite enough not to ask why Vera looked so tired, which was appreciated. Vera now seemed to realize what she had truly needed. Just a friendly face to ease the weight she carried.

To add to the cruel irony, it hadn't stopped raining for the past three days. It was already past 7 PM when she stepped off the bus, cold and soaked to the bone, having left her umbrella at the gym. Her place was just one block down the street, but it felt like ten miles in this weather. Her legs moved on their own, and suddenly, the Cups & Blossoms' bell was ringing above her head. The warm, floral scent wrapped around her like a blanket, but it was another kind of welcome that surprised her — a smile from the café owner, soft and unassuming. She was also polite enough not to ask why Vera looked so tired, which was appreciated. Vera now seemed to realize what she had truly needed. Just a friendly face to ease the weight she carried.
questions.stem: 다음 괄호 안의 단어를 문맥에 맞게 변형하시오.

det.analysis: assume(동사: 추정하다) → unassuming(형용사: 겸손한): un- 접두사 + assuming = 겸손한, 소박한
det.tip: assume → assuming(잘난 체하는) → unassuming(겸손한). un- 접두사로 반대 의미

밑줄 친 <u>which</u>가 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

She was also polite enough not to ask why Vera looked so tired, <u>which</u> was appreciated.
ch: the café owner's not asking about Vera's condition

det.korean: which = 카페 주인이 Vera의 상태에 대해 묻지 않은 것. 계속적 관계대명사.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 묻지 않은 배려: 직전 절 전체를 선행사로 하는 계속적 which
❌ ① 미소: 직전 내용이 아님
❌ ② 피곤함: 감사할 대상 아님
❌ ④ 꽃 향기: 다른 문장
det.tip: 계속적 관계대명사 which: 앞 절 전체(묻지 않은 것)를 가리킴
